answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 15799 Country: India Title: Is it permissible to seat on chaire if 1.Some one reciting quran by sitting on ground-In this case level of quran is low while we will be on higt. 2.Some one eating food by seating on ground- In this case level of food is low while we will be on higt? Question: Is it permissible to seat on chaire if 1.Some one reciting quran by sitting on ground-In this case level of quran is low while we will be on higt. 2.Some one eating food by seating on ground- In this case level of food is low while we will be on higt? Answer ID: 15799 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1927/1549=H=1430) (1) It is alright. (2) It is makrooh and against the etiquettes of the Quran to sit on higher place before one reciting the Quran. (3) It is allowable, but it is better for you to sit down on ground like him. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
